response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, versatile senior/staff engineer with 15+ years of full-stack, embedded, and infrastructure work, and a CS bachelor's degree that meets the baseline education requirement. However, the role requires 8+ years specifically building AI-driven solutions, deep cloud-platform AI system design, data pipelines for AI, vector databases, and RAG architectures — none of which appear in his history except a very recent (4-month) exposure to MCP tooling and agentic infrastructure at his current job. This is far short of the depth and tenure the role demands.
strengths: 15+ years of senior/staff-level software engineering across web, mobile, embedded and infra domains
Current hands-on exposure to MCP servers and agentic workflow tooling at re:cinq
Strong track record of technical leadership, mentoring, workshops, and open-source contributions
concerns: No demonstrated 8+ years of AI-specific solution development — AI/agentic experience is only ~4 months old
No evidence of RAG architectures, vector databases, or LLM evaluation/observability work
Limited and shallow cloud platform experience (brief AWS CDK mention) versus the deep cloud AI system design required

key_factors.factor: Strong general staff-level engineering and current MCP exposure
